note: Unchanged V3 entry rules including partial aggregated bars. Decisions at M5 close; fill next full M5 open after alert delay with risk/RR validation; TP2 exit; SL first on ambiguous bars; max 72 bars. One alert per directional setup cycle; two closed M5 bars without setup or a direction change rearm alerts. Target path tracked separately after TP2; not additional paper wins. Historical replay is not exact wall-clock live execution.

execution_timing.assumption: Decision at M5 close; simulated alert after configured delay; first full M5 open at/after alert. 1 second models exclusion of the in-progress alert candle, not measured broker latency.

limitations: Broker spread/slippage/commission not configured; results are gross.
Provider schedule fetched after the fact; historical revisions and missing provider events cannot be reconstructed.
